en: Hey, welcome

en: You've finally awakened from your reality
ja: 君の現実は ようやく醒めたんだ

en: I have very good news for you
ja: とっても良いお知らせだよ

en: There is "no future" here
ja: ここには「未来」は存在しないんだ

en: You don't have to brush your teeth, you don't have to eat any vegetables
ja: めんどくさい歯磨きもいらないし 野菜を食べなくてもいい

en: What's more, you are spared from seeing your family you hate
ja: 大嫌いな家族とも会わなくて済むんだよ

en: First, stack these balls up high in the sky
ja: まずは このボールをあの空高く積み上げてね

en: Until I let you stop, keep doing it on and on and on

en: If you can't do it all, I'll never, never let you through

en: This isn't a lukewarm school, don't get that wrong
ja: ここは生ぬるい学校じゃないんだから 勘違いしないでね

en: Never mind that, come play with me
ja: やっぱりそんなのいいから 一緒に遊ぼうよ

en: Don't worry about the end of life
ja: 命の終わりなんて気にしないでさ
